span.p:
One fact from Muse Spark 1.3
“Never touch the main switch box with wet hands.”
quote · turn · time · noun · point · safety: electricity

span.p:
1 · The words · code
the quote is in its own speaking turn,
word for word, at the right moment,
and at least 6 characters long

span.p:
2 · The pixels · SAM 3.1 + code
SAM 3.1 outlines the noun on the still;
Muse Spark's point must fall inside
a mask with confidence ≥ 0.5

3 · A second reading · Muse Wonder 1.0
electricity, gas and fire facts: it reads
the words, the turn, the still and SAM's box,
and may only uphold or flag
